title: Probabilistic Models of Cognition
text:
Home
This is a “port” of Goodman et al’s book Probabilistic Models of Cognition into Quarto, with a few changes to help us integrate the material better with DSAN 5650: Causal Inference for Computational Social Science (e.g., allowing us to cross-reference code and figures, include PDFs of the readings, and auto-grade the end-of-chapter exercises!)
Use the sidebar to the left or the link at the bottom of this page to get started!

title: 1  Introduction
text:
This is a book created from markdown and executable code.
See Knuth (1984) for additional discussion of literate programming.




Knuth, Donald E. 1984. “Literate Programming.” Comput. J. (USA) 27 (2): 97–111. https://doi.org/10.1093/comjnl/27.2.97.

title: 2  Summary
text: In summary, this book has no content whatsoever.
